items.author: linafox.bsky.social
items.context: Anyone else play #StardewValley? I see it on iOS and I kinda want it but I also don’t wanna spend money and be bored lol I’ve seen over the years people love it and I do love a cozy game
items.text: If you love cozy games, Stardew is a very safe bet. It's slow and gentle, you set your own pace, and the first few in-game days show quickly whether the loop clicks for you.

items.author: renochevre.bsky.social
items.context: My fav type of game actually is Chore Simulator 3000 (while also never touching the main storyline until I absolutely have to). "Who are these farming sims/railroad sims/open world/etc. games for?" Me, next question.
items.text: Same here. A good chore loop is oddly relaxing, and farming sims are made for exactly that.
